note: Research Part 2 does not define a new benchmark corpus in R2-M0.1. This file declares how later experiments are expected to reference workloads, without duplicating Research Part 1 data.
canonical_workload_source: workloads/ (Research Part 1 canonical workload definitions, e.g. workloads/v2/*.json), referenced by name and version, never copied or mutated.
selection_policy: Each future experiment config must name an explicit workload id + version from the canonical source above. Where the correct workload selection for a given R2-NN experiment requires a scientific decision not yet made, it must be recorded here as unresolved, not guessed.

unresolved_selections.open_point: Which workload family/families to use for expert-frequency characterization (single family vs. the full Research Part 1 workload set) is not yet decided.
The train/benchmark split convention for the prediction benchmark (reuse Research Part 1 dev/eval split vs. a new split) is not yet decided.
